description: Finds Sigma Prep math worksheet topics (Pre-Algebra, Algebra 1, Geometry, Algebra 2, Precalculus, Calculus, Statistics) that match a request in plain words. Returns each topic's id, the difficulty levels it offers, its question types and its page on sigmaprep.io.

course.description: Optional course name to narrow the search, e.g. "Algebra 2".

query.description: What the worksheet is about, in plain words, e.g. "factoring trinomials" or "law of sines".

name: search_worksheets
title: Find worksheet topics
